parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use the log quotient law, e.g. $\ln(3/5^x)=\ln3-\ln5^x$, or the product law, e.g. $\ln5^x+\ln(2^{3x-4})$ - M1. May work in any log base for the first three marks.

Use the log power law, e.g. $\ln5^x=x\ln5$ or $\ln(2^{3x-4})=(3x-4)\ln2$ - M1. Condone missing brackets if recovered later.

Obtain a correct exact expression for $x$, e.g. $(\ln3+4\ln2)/(3\ln2+\ln5)$ - A1.

Obtain final answer $\ln48/\ln40$ - A1. Do not ISW. A final $\log_{40}48$ scores three marks only; no working scores 0.

Alternative method: rearrange to $(2^3\times5)^x=3\times2^4$ - B1, OE. Use the log power law on $a^{bx}=c$, e.g. $x\ln(2^3\times5)=\ln(3\times2^4)$ - M1. Obtain $x=\ln(3\times2^4)/\ln(2^3\times5)$ - A1. Obtain $\ln48/\ln40$ - A1, with the same guidance.

Printed total: 4.
